Bb&T Corp decreased its stake in Signature (SBNY) by 37.9% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bb&T Corp sold 4,242 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.90% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6,952 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $955,000, down from 11,194 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bb&T Corp who had been investing in Signature for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $6.99 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.22% or $0.29 during the last trading session, reaching $130.22. About 298,888 shares traded. Signature Bank (NASDAQ:SBNY) has declined 1.22% since April 29, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 12.77% the S&P500.
